title: AI trial matching / site selection 的 transport 與 fairness
statement: trial-site/clinician/patient matching模型在不同therapeutic areas、regions與demographic compositions下能否保持recruitment效能與公平性。
known_result: 2026 Nature Health DocTr以claims、trial text與historical enrolment做clinician matching，並同時最佳化accuracy、demographic fairness與operational efficiency。
open_gap: historical-enrolment feedback bias、competition between trials、new disease areas與actual prospective recruitment impact。
first_task: 用公開/合成matching graph重現ranking baseline，做region/therapeutic-area held-out與demographic audit。
validation_limits: historical enrolment不是理想ground truth；推薦更準不等於prospective recruitment必然改善。
completion_criterion: 在held-out trials/regions保持預先設定matching與fairness性能，prospective utility需另驗證。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。本庫只做研究方法、公開/去識別資料與simulation，不提供個人診療或自動臨床決策。每輪重查最新指南、驗證研究與修訂。
